Initial release of the work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper skill.

- Provides practical support for bug fixing, security hardening, reliability improvements, and skill adaptations inspired by validated SkillScan-style workflow demand.

- Triggered by keywords related to work productivity, security, bug fixing, and workflow requirements.
